item: Script-code lines and LaTeX command names are blanked before tokenising (R699 causes 3 and 4, Lane V)
summary: The 2026-10-06 triage found jQuery calls left in ko page bodies (addclass, attr, pdesc, pmurl) and LaTeX macros in en articles (mathcal, mathbf); the stoplist bridge hid only the words already seen. strip_non_prose (both extractors, after the markup and URL strips) blanks a line that reads as script code (a jQuery/DOM idiom with at least 12% code punctuation, or 35% code punctuation alone) and, only in a text that carries a known LaTeX macro, every backslash command and environment name (braced arguments stay, so \text{mass} keeps mass). Same length out as in, so offsets stay true; linear on hostile input. Escaped newlines and Windows paths keep their words. Keyboard noise (dhmkkh) is not addressed. INDEXER_VERSION 2 (shared with cause 1). Old rows converge only after a re-index.
